# regapi Provider

Manage RegAPI contacts, default contacts, domains and registrations.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "regapi" {
  # Defaults to https://api.regapi.dev.
  # endpoint = "https://api.staging.regapi.dev"

  # Or set the REGAPI_API_KEY environment variable.
  api_key = var.regapi_api_key
}

variable "regapi_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) A RegAPI API key of the account. Defaults to the REGAPI_API_KEY environment variable.
- `endpoint` (String) The RegAPI base URL. Defaults to https://api.regapi.dev.
